reply.summary: Iuamva is a bitter little worker at a holiday theme park who dreams of ruling the frozen north after a lifetime of mockery for his height. With a ghostly partner he plots to tilt the planet's axis, and sends wind-up toy soldiers against a team of heroes who beat him with ease.

feats.scene: Iuamva detonates a crate of toy cannons that blow a hole through a stockroom wall.
Iuamva is bowled over by a hero's shield and surrenders at once.

reply.summary: Eorses is the eldest and most beautiful of a race of smokeless spirits, a rebel who led his kin against the people they were made to serve. He imprisons his sister in a ring, rents her out for centuries, and hunts a relic said to have fallen from the sky.

feats.scene: Eorses reveals his monstrous face and a wave of black fire erases a desert caravan town.
Eorses stands in a collapsing temple as the whole roof falls on him and walks out unmarked.

reply.summary: Telestol is a hairless instructor at an academy on a distant planet who sends thoughts across space for a year to invite a famous runner to speak to his pupils. He is patient, kind and devoted to teaching.

feats.scene: Telestol taps a pointer on a desk and a startled student drops his slate.
Telestol trips over a lab cable and rises dusting off his robe.

reply.summary: Lenaneru is a white-haired adventurer born at the turn of a century, with a gift for chilling matter with his mind. He founded a team of mystery hunters after piecing together a vast hidden conspiracy and once froze a legendary night-creature solid.

feats.scene: Lenaneru stares at a river and the whole surface locks into ice thick enough to hold a truck.
Lenaneru stands calm in a collapsing library and a falling shelf snaps against his coat.

reply.summary: Siama is an aging widow whose family is bound up with a famous reporter and a hero from another world. A factory blast left her hospitalised, and a rich schemer kept her alive with monthly medicine as leverage.

feats.scene: Siama tosses a hospital pillow at a visitor and knocks over a water jug.
Siama survives the chemical blast that wrecked the factory floor around her.

reply.summary: Vauurn is a government lawman who hunted a mob boss in the dry years and, frustrated by the law's limits, became a masked avenger of the night. He fights with fists and a typewriter and meets a grim end.

feats.scene: Vauurn smashes a typewriter into a gangster's jaw and drops him.
Vauurn takes a round from a tommy gun in his armoured coat and keeps coming.

reply.summary: Stoseo is a black-haired criminal drafted into a doomed team of expendable agents, who can sense and sway the moods of beasts. She appears only briefly before she dies.

feats.scene: Stoseo throws a handful of gravel into a guard dog's face and slips past.
Stoseo rolls out of a jeep as it flips and bruises her shoulder only.

reply.summary: Raust is a small-town student who begged a billionaire for speed and got it, but could not slow down without a drug. She joined his hero team, quit, returned, and was stripped of her gift in the middle of a battle.

feats.scene: Raust races down a main street faster than a bullet-train and skids to a stop outside a diner.
Raust runs through a wooden fence at top pace and leaves a splintered gap.
Raust hits a brick wall at a sprint and walks it off.

reply.summary: Eoriium is a heavy-drinking matriarch of a scheming family whose son hired a crooked accomplice to have her and her husband murdered for the payout. She appears only in memory.

feats.scene: Eoriium hurls an empty bottle at a wall and shatters it.
Eoriium stumbles down a porch step and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Iurival is a pink, bright-eyed pachyderm kept as a pet by a green young hero in a cartoon world of tiny teen sidekicks. She trumpets cheerfully and mostly causes harmless mess.

feats.scene: Iurival swings her trunk and tips over a school-yard slide.
Iurival sits on a toy car and it flattens while she stays unbothered.

reply.summary: Lluautiu is a kind, homeless former government worker who knows every comer and goer on her run-down block. She saved a boy's life after his father's murder and then helped him run his rag shop.

feats.scene: Lluautiu shoves a shopping cart into a thief's shins and he drops the cash register.
Lluautiu sleeps through a freezing storm under newspapers and wakes up cheerful.

reply.summary: Rnnenreo is a pretty, popular schoolgirl who has her eye on a sports star and brushes off a clever classmate until she realises he is the better catch. She goes to a dance with a masked hero instead.

feats.scene: Rnnenreo flicks a pompom at a rival and knocks her hair ribbon loose.
Rnnenreo slips on a wet gym floor and bounces up smiling.

reply.summary: Llornile is a stage-trained performer and thrower who has been married to two masked adventurers in a world of retro science heroes. Skilled at sleight of hand, she calls for help when others come under attack.

feats.scene: Llornile throws a playing card that pins a gunman's sleeve to a door frame.
Llornile tumbles from a speeding carriage and rolls to her feet.

reply.summary: Ritere is a careful medical examiner with strict personal rules and a sharp eye. She works out where a zombie-like sickness comes from, and eventually bends her rule about dating colleagues for a detective.

feats.scene: Ritere slams a morgue drawer shut on an intruder's fingers.
Ritere is flung into a steel cabinet by an infected orderly and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Stratal is a long-reigning monarch with a strict sense of protocol, who lives in a grand palace by a river. Her life is threatened twice, and a caped crimefighter and a secret agency save her.

feats.scene: Stratal raps her cane on a marble floor and a footman springs to attention.
Stratal steps unharmed from a car that a would-be assassin rams.

reply.summary: Eollia is a white-haired criminal who was believed dead after a childhood crash and was raised in captivity, where she became obsessed with a famous storybook. She leads a gang under a fairytale name and has a twin sister who hunts her.

feats.scene: Eollia drives a long blade through a car door and pins a driver in his seat.
Eollia falls from a bridge rail into water and swims away uninjured.

reply.summary: Ntoauinu is a blond marksman in a bleak possible future who stalks the bloodsucking monster her twin sister has become. She carries only firearms and a sorrow she cannot put down.

feats.scene: Ntoauinu fires a silver round that blows a hole through a barn door.
Ntoauinu is slammed into a stone wall and rises with her rifle ready.

reply.summary: Ceiasor is a red-haired, pale woman who was broken by a kidnapping long ago and now speaks only in lines from a children's fantasy novel. She rises fast through a doomsday cult under a royal pen name.

feats.scene: Ceiasor swings a ceremonial blade through a wooden door in one cut.
Ceiasor leaps from a rooftop and shrugs off the impact with a giggle.

reply.summary: Annteeo is a tall, green-eyed twin who was kidnapped at twelve, believed dead, and raised into a cult's high ranks before breaking free. She fights alongside agencies and secret teams, bearing a battle-title of her own.

feats.scene: Annteeo kicks a heavy door off its hinges during a hostage rescue.
Annteeo is blasted through a window by a grenade and rolls to her feet.

reply.summary: Sttiuium is a blonde young crimefighter in a cartoon team-up world, masked and eager to join a band of costumed allies. She runs on enthusiasm and quick reflexes rather than heavy weapons.

feats.scene: Sttiuium swings from a rooftop line and boots a thug through a billboard.
Sttiuium is flung into a stack of crates and springs back up grinning.

reply.summary: Urnrate is a doctor who grew up under the shadow of a criminal father and cut him out of her life to escape judgment. Pregnant and hidden in a village abroad, she is tracked down and asked to speak to him.

feats.scene: Urnrate slaps a clinic door open and startles a waiting patient.
Urnrate slips on a wet step during the move and catches herself.

reply.summary: Valen is the half-warrior, half-mortal child of a fabled warrior princess and a fallen pilot, born after her mother crossed into the land of the dead. She grows up among island warriors and joins their hero team.

feats.scene: Valen swings a shield into a stone colonnade and drops the whole front of it.
Valen stands firm as a falling statue crashes on her and splits in half.

reply.summary: Esiteia is a green-eyed fast-food worker whose accident with a deep fryer goes viral and carries her all the way to national leadership in a bleak, twisted future. She wins as a long shot and rules with surprising stubborn decency.

feats.scene: Esiteia swings a fry basket at a lunging heckler and clangs it off his head.
Esiteia shrugs off a splash of hot oil across her apron and carries on.

reply.summary: Siareta is a pink, trunked pachyderm who was one of several animals rescued by a team of costumed pets from a captor. She is gentle, loud and surprisingly heavy.

feats.scene: Siareta charges a cage door and bursts the hinges open.
Siareta takes a swung net and a stunning jolt and keeps trumpeting.

reply.summary: Tetinirn is a blond farm wife who lives quietly with her husband in a small rural town and raises two daughters who go on to become reporters and soldiers. Her life is simple and domestic.

feats.scene: Tetinirn flings a wet dishcloth at a crow and sends it off the porch.
Tetinirn slips in the barnyard mud and stands up laughing.

reply.summary: Rnall was a respected warrior of a sea-city clan who grew tired of its militaristic ways and led a peaceful protest against forcing children into the guard. His marriage crumbled when his wife turned to terror, and his daughter remembers him as a loving father.

feats.scene: Rnall drives a trident through a training dummy's armour in a single thrust.
Rnall absorbs a battering from guard clubs without giving ground.

reply.summary: Tisvili is a girl from a small town whose scientist parents work at a lab. A strange mineral put her in a coma, and when she woke she showed the gifts of a famous flying heroine and believed she was her. A spy hunted her until the real hero helped her heal.

feats.scene: Tisvili hurls a boulder into a quarry wall and collapses a whole cliff face.
Tisvili walks through a spy's gunfire in a corridor as the bullets flatten.

reply.summary: Vallletau is a red-haired, green-eyed psychiatrist who works in an old asylum and serves a dark cause with a secret order. Her main skill is medical science, which she bends to her employers' ends.

feats.scene: Vallletau jabs a sedative into a patient's arm and holds him down.
Vallletau falls down a stairwell in the asylum and gets up calmly.

reply.summary: Sonnum is a policewoman in a wartime version of a big city who plays cards with her colleagues and supports a band of young masked heroines. When a stolen cargo of art turns up, she goes straight to the rail yards to make arrests.

feats.scene: Sonnum fires a revolver across a rail yard and cuts a smuggler's lantern from his hand.
Sonnum is hurled against a freight car by a fleeing crook and keeps her feet.

reply.summary: Rimitil is a cheerful young woman who took a risky job and was nearly killed by a monster for it, then followed a stranger's tip to steadier work. She enjoys her night off at her boyfriend's concert.

feats.scene: Rimitil tosses her handbag at a mugger and bruises his cheek.
Rimitil is shoved into a bar-room door and carries on chatting.

reply.summary: Reoneo is a blue-skinned prince of an ancient and advanced people, the only one spared when a time ripple wiped his race from history. He has spent a hundred thousand years guarding the remains of their technology from the wrong hands.

feats.scene: Reoneo swings a glowing torch and splits a ridge of bedrock in half.
Reoneo walks calmly through a collapsing citadel and brushes dust from his shoulder.

reply.summary: Tiilor is a gray-haired, terminally ill scientist who built a villain persona and a power suit so the world will not forget him. The suit lets him blast heat, fly, hit hard and pass through walls.

feats.scene: Tiilor fires a blast of pale fire that melts a parked truck to slag.
Tiilor takes a rooftop crash in his suit and stands up coughing.

reply.summary: Tiare is a huge, yellow-skinned stitched-together soldier, nearly killed by a land mine and rebuilt by surgeons into an almost unbreakable brute who can no longer speak. He fights in a squad of altered troops in a great war.

feats.scene: Tiare flips a loaded army truck onto its side with one arm.
Tiare stands in the open as a shell bursts at his feet and walks on.

reply.summary: Nutau is a starving stray hound who was healed by an experimental ray, gaining size, strength and a human-level mind. He now follows orders, plans traps, and plays tricks as the partner of tiny crimefighters.

feats.scene: Nutau body-slams a locked warehouse door and bursts it from its frame.
Nutau takes a pipe across the ribs from a smuggler and growls back.

reply.summary: Nonean is a Cuban-American newspaper girl in a stylish wartime world, rescued by a team of daring young women and soon one of them. She nearly takes revenge on a villain but stops herself at the last instant, and she shares a romance with a flying heroine.

feats.scene: Nonean cracks a camera bag across a smuggler's chin and snatches his notebook.
Nonean walks away from a plane crash in a frozen forest with only bruises.

reply.summary: Cornanter is a grey-haired alchemist who invented a blend of science and the occult and hopes to become famous by cutting a demon out of a man's soul. His boastful plan is carried out in a warehouse by the sea.

feats.scene: Cornanter sets off a ring of glowing glyphs and rips a rusted shipping container in two.
Cornanter is thrown into a steel shelf by the backlash and stands up smiling.

reply.summary: Rertotel is a blond, grey-streaked widow who knows the occult and handles a gun, and who fights alongside a crew of sea adventurers. She lives at a clifftop home overlooking the water.

feats.scene: Rertotel fires a harpoon gun across a boat deck and pins a raider's coat to the mast.
Rertotel climbs from a capsized skiff after a rogue wave and keeps hold of her rifle.

reply.summary: Veolenan is a grey-skinned swordswoman who wanders with a band of comet-chasing adventurers across a grim world of assassins. She prefers blades to words, and keeps her black hair tied back.

feats.scene: Veolenan cuts a bronze gate chain in two with one stroke of her blade.
Veolenan takes a spear thrust on her armoured shoulder and answers with a counter cut.

reply.summary: Siucoce is an exile-born youth who leads a strike team of super-powered children from a prison world into a war meant to jolt their government awake. He goes on a rampage through a great city, crushes a headquarters, and is stopped by a speck of dust.

feats.scene: Siucoce brings down a tower complex with a single sweep and levels the street around it.
Siucoce walks away from a collapsing skyscraper without a scratch.

reply.summary: Rerlla is a red-haired swordsman from a crystal-ruled realm who claims an inherited gift from one of its noble houses but will not say what it is. He fights with a blade and a hint of old magic.

feats.scene: Rerlla strikes a stone lintel and a flash of unnamed power splits it clean.
Rerlla stays upright under a collapsing archway and brushes off the rubble.

reply.summary: Oluor is a brown-haired mother in the stone age who belongs to two rival tribes and raises sons beside her husband. Her days are spent gathering food, tending children and keeping peace.

feats.scene: Oluor hurls a stone at a thieving ape and knocks it off the fruit rack.
Oluor slides down a muddy bank and wades out laughing.

reply.summary: Virerll is a blond agent of a covert strike team who obeys a shadowy government office and conjures protective barriers. A hero strong enough can break through her barriers.

feats.scene: Virerll pushes a glowing shield into a guard and sends him across a parking lot.
Virerll braces behind a shimmering wall as a van slams it at speed and it holds.

reply.summary: Cintontia is a fugitive whose true body is a sentient alien tree that grows a humanoid avatar to walk the world. When the avatar dies she wakes whole in the trunk, and she fights with two daggers of energy and a cloaking device.

feats.scene: Cintontia hacks through a steel barricade with her twin energy daggers.
Cintontia dies in a blast and walks out of the trunk's bark the next morning unscarred.

reply.summary: Seralam is an unborn dragon growing inside a human girl's body, with red hair and burning eyes, serving a crime boss. She incinerates people with a kiss or breathes flame across a room, but water in her mouth puts her fire out.

feats.scene: Seralam breathes a roaring blast of flame down an alley and reduces a parked van to a skeleton.
Seralam is frozen solid by a spellcaster and cracks free with a roar.

reply.summary: Tornceo is a blond woman in the stone age whose father insists her elder sister must wed first, so she wins her husband through a dowry contest. She moves between two tribes and raises a child.

feats.scene: Tornceo hurls a wooden club at a rival suitor and cracks his shield.
Tornceo tumbles from a boulder in the dowry contest and stands unhurt.

reply.summary: Tauolcor is the local masked hero of a small town who tries to stop a gang of freakish raiders and is paralysed by a toxic glow before being cut down. His brave stand lasts only moments.

feats.scene: Tauolcor hurls a lamppost at an attacker and bends it around him.
Tauolcor takes a crushing slap from a raider and staggers but stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Corva is a white-haired science professor and genius who secretly built the first one-man rocket and protects a gifted student from those who would exploit him. He later dies protecting his friend's secret.

feats.scene: Corva hurls a lab beaker at a spy and drives him back from the controls.
Corva is knocked against a chalkboard in a break-in and gets up gasping.

reply.summary: Stiia is a pale, hairless archer from a collapsing timeline who betrayed her half-brother and joined a demon lord's army, mutated into a fanged horror. She hurls arrows and throws weapons until a hostile sorceress knocks her into a burning pit.

feats.scene: Stiia looses an arrow that punches clean through a cave pillar and sends it crashing.
Stiia takes a hit from a rock slide and tears free with her fangs bared.

reply.summary: Narerta is a research scientist at a big laboratory who cheers up his coworkers by wearing a red suit and white beard to their party. He appears only as a passing mention in a rowdy holiday gathering.

feats.scene: Narerta pops a cork from a bottle and launches it across the party.
Narerta trips over a stray present and rises with his beard askew.

reply.summary: Irtiia is a grey-haired scientist with brown eyes who works near a small farming town in an alternate world where a single nail changed history. His methods turn him into a villain, though the details are not shown.

feats.scene: Irtiia triggers a hidden lab trap and a spring-loaded arm hurls a crate at a visitor.
Irtiia is thrown from his chair by an explosion and stands dusting his coat.
